tables.text_helper: Table 63, "EXTI controller register map and reset values", in section 14.5.16 (EXTI register map) on page 278. Register map: offsets, 32-bit field layout and reset values for 19 registers: EXTI_RTSR1, EXTI_FTSR1, EXTI_SWIER1, EXTI_RPR1, EXTI_FPR1, Reserved, EXTI_RTSR2, EXTI_FTSR2, EXTI_SWIER2, EXTI_RPR2, EXTI_FPR2, EXTI_EXTICR1 and 7 more.
